sources.observed_evidence: Official COR3 financial-summary portal exposes an Export to Excel control and identifies FEMA/COR3 data sources. The portal displayed data as of 2026-06-16 during this review.
sources.expected_operator_input: COR3 Transparency Portal Excel exports under data/raw/COR3/
sources.blocker: No COR3 workbook bytes were present in the connected evidence or execution environment. The separate download_cor3.py endpoint list remains explicitly unverified and was not executed.

sources.observed_evidence: HUD exposes a public DRGR data portal, but the repository source contract specifically requires authorized local exports and forbids credential automation.
sources.expected_operator_input: Authorized DRGR CSV/XLSX exports under data/manual/hud_drgr/ or documented legacy raw paths
sources.blocker: No authorized export was supplied; no login, MFA, credential use, or automated extraction was attempted.

sources.observed_evidence: Puerto Rico Department of Justice is the official custodian of the public cabilderos registry created under Executive Order OE-2019-031. Public registration details are available, with legislative chambers publishing supplementary records.
sources.expected_operator_input: Official registry CSV/XLSX exports under data/raw/Cabilderos/
sources.provenance_correction: Producer documentation corrected from Oficina de Etica Gubernamental to Department of Justice custody.
sources.blocker: No complete machine-readable export bytes were present in the execution environment.

sources.observed_evidence: The Puerto Rico Comptroller contract registry supports entity-filtered contract searches and operator-requested exports. The public interface documents an on-screen limit of 30,000 records and email delivery for exports.
sources.expected_operator_input: PRASA/AAA contract CSV/XLSX exports under data/raw/PRASA/
sources.blocker: No PRASA-filtered export was supplied. Export delivery is an operator action and may require partitioning when the result exceeds the interface limit.
